name: opencode-zh-bundle
description: Minimal local distribution bundle for Chinese OpenCode quota, sidebar, Matt Workshop, and GPT reset-card plugins.

scripts.check:matt-workshop: node scripts/sync-matt-skills.mjs --check && npm run build:matt-workshop -- --noEmit && node scripts/check-matt-build.mjs && node scripts/verify-matt-workshop.mjs && node scripts/stage-runtime.mjs --check
scripts.test:quota-zh:fast: vitest run --config plugins/opencode-quota-zh/vitest.config.ts tests/lib.quota-snapshot-projection.test.ts tests/lib.maintainer-announcements.test.ts tests/plugin.maintainer-announcements.test.ts tests/lib.quota-status.test.ts tests/lib.init-installer.test.ts tests/lib.quota-alert-metrics.test.ts tests/lib.quota-snapshot-danger.test.ts tests/providers.deepseek.test.ts tests/lib.api-key-provider-queries.test.ts
scripts.check:quota-zh: npm run build:quota-zh && npm run typecheck:quota-zh && npm run test:quota-zh && npm run build:quota-zh:runtime -- --check && npm run stage:runtime -- --check
scripts.check: npm run check:matt-workshop && npm run check:quota-zh && node scripts/verify.mjs
